purpose: Teach: 河上/金田/稲本/厚木/江崎/宇野/久留米/青葉

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の河上部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: I want you to welcome our new department head, Kawakami.
lines.style: Authoritative opening. Measured pace, clear diction. Each directive lands with quiet weight. Not raised, but unmistakably in command.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の金田課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate Sales Manager Kaneda's travel schedule.
lines.style: Brisk, efficient acknowledgment. Clipped slightly at the edges—showing immediate mental engagement with the task. Professional, no flourish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術担当の稲本主任にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: I'm assigning the project to Inamoto, our lead technical coordinator.
lines.style: Steady, declarative. No inflection for persuasion—it's already decided. Direct eye contact implied. Speaks as though writing it into the record.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。神奈川県厚木市の工場を強化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll strengthen our factory operations in Atsugi, Kanagawa.
lines.style: Quick confirmation, moving into action. Slight upturn at the end—absorbing and already planning the next step. Efficient, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、菓子のお取引で江崎グリコ系列と連携しろ
lines.en: We're going to coordinate with the Ezaki Glico group on confectionery contracts.
lines.style: Calm authority. Slight emphasis on the partnership aspect—this is strategic, not routine. Speaks as though laying out the board.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の宇野様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. I'll implement the PR strategy Uno has prepared.
lines.style: Swift acknowledgment. Minimal pause—this fits into the flow of directives. Professional, ready for the next item.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、福岡県久留米の支店を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our branch operations in Kurume, Fukuoka.
lines.style: Same steady command as before. Clipped, final. No room for questions. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。研究所の青葉キャンパスの予算を確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll review the budget allocation for our Aoba research campus.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly fuller than before—this is the last directive and he gives it the weight it deserves. Grounded, ready to execute.
